title: Thermal Entanglement and Out-of-Equilibrium Thermodynamics in 1D Bose gases
summary: We investigate entanglement in and out of equilibrium in a one-dimensional Bose gas in its low-energy Bogoliubov regime. In this Gaussian setting, the state is fully characterized by its covariance matrix, which allows us to detect and quantify entanglement using a covariance-based framework and associated entanglement monotones.
